name: Bodyweight Squat
summary: A foundational squat with no equipment that trains the thighs and glutes and builds the movement pattern for loaded squats.
setup: Stand with feet about shoulder width apart, toes turned out slightly.
Hold your arms out in front or clasp your hands at chest height for balance.
Brace your abs and keep your chest tall.
execution: Push your hips back and bend your knees at the same time.
Lower until your thighs are about parallel to the floor, or as deep as you can with a flat back and heels down.
Keep your knees tracking in line with your toes.
Press through the whole foot to stand up and squeeze your glutes at the top.
mistakes: Heels lifting off the floor: widen the stance slightly or hold the arms forward for balance.
Knees caving in: push them out in line with the toes.
Rounding the lower back at the bottom: reduce depth until you can stay neutral.
Leaning too far forward: keep the chest up and look straight ahead.
